episodes.title: Welcome to Monsters, Incorporated
episodes.summary: When Tylor Tuskmon arrives at Monsters Incorporated to begin his dream job as a Scarer, he discovers that scaring is out and laughter is in.  As a result he is temporarily reassigned to MIFT, the Monsters Incorporated Facilities Team.

episodes.title: Meet MIFT
episodes.summary: When Tylor is initiated into MIFT during a bizarre ritual, he wants nothing more than to get away from his odd coworkers.  But when an emergency strikes Monsters, Inc., MIFT kicks into action and Tylor develops a hint of respect for the misfit team.

episodes.title: The Damaged Room
episodes.summary: When a human baby's room is damaged by a Jokester, Tylor has his first experience working with MIFT on the repairs. While the room is repaired, Mike and Sulley must take care of a human baby.

episodes.title: The Big Wazowskis
episodes.summary: Hoping to get in good with Mike, Tylor signs MIFT up to be Mike's bowling team for the annual Monsters, Inc. Bowl-off-a-thon ... only to discover that everyone at MIFT stinks at bowling.

episodes.title: The Cover Up
episodes.summary: When Fritz goes on vacation and leaves Duncan in charge, MIFT causes a power outage and an inspector is called to investigate.

episodes.title: The Vending Machine
episodes.summary: Tylor's job is threatened when he breaks MIFT's favorite vending machine. Meanwhile, Mike tries boosting morale at Monsters, Inc.

episodes.title: Adorable Returns
episodes.summary: Tylor mistakenly allows the banished "Adorable Snowman" to return to Monsters, Inc. Fearing he'll also be banished, Tylor struggles to get him back before he's discovered and Val searches for the secret to why the snowman was banished in the first place.

episodes.title: Little Monsters
episodes.summary: Tylor sees an opportunity to get promoted as Jokester during Mini-Monster Day at Monsters, Inc. when he is paired with Ms. Flint's daughter. Can he get her to laugh?

episodes.title: Bad Hair Day
episodes.summary: Tylor sets his sights on becoming the perfect MIFTer. But when he loses the sacred hair of David, a former employee, Tylor must get it back before the MIFT team finds out.

episodes.title: It's Laughter They're After
episodes.summary: Tylor achieves his dream and is promoted to Jokester… but he feels torn on leaving MIFT.

episodes.title: A Monstrous Homecoming
episodes.summary: It's homecoming weekend at Monsters University, and Tylor Tuskmon is being celebrated as a former Scream King.

episodes.title: The C.R.E.E.P. Show
episodes.summary: The MIFTers join Mike and Sulley in representing Monsters, Inc., at the C.R.E.E.P. Show, an energy convection where they hope to promote laugh power to industry professionals.

episodes.title: Setting the Table
episodes.summary: Tylor is invited to a fancy dinner with Johnny Worthington, but it's on the same night - and at the same restaurant - as a party for Fritz!

episodes.title: Opening Doors
episodes.summary: Johnny takes Tylor on a tour of FearCo. When Tylor is late returning from his visit, Val must cover for him.

episodes.title: It's Coming From Inside the House
episodes.summary: The Tuskmon family is having a stoop sale, but Tylor struggles to part with his childhood scaring memorabilia.

episodes.title: Field of Screams
episodes.summary: At the annual Monsters, Inc., vs. FearCo softball game, Val tries to tell Tylor about a job offer from Mike and Sulley.

episodes.title: Monsters in the Dark
episodes.summary: Mike and Sulley lead a morale-boosting company retreat in the spooky sub-basement of Monsters, Inc.

episodes.title: Lights! Camera! Chaos!
episodes.summary: When news anchors Jack and Jill visit Monsters, Inc., for an interview, Mike and Sulley hope to show off laugh power to all of Monstropolis.

episodes.title: Descent into Fear
episodes.summary: Tylor and Val start their first days at their new jobs: Tylor as a Scarer at FearCo and Val as a Jokester at Monsters, Inc.

episodes.title: Powerless
episodes.summary: After a devastating blackout, Tylor must reconnect with Val to bring power back to Monstropolis.
